selector.rationale: The patient's extremely high body temperature and the context of being in a non-air-conditioned room during a heat wave strongly support heat stroke as the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cerebellar Infarction
rejected.why: Initial head MRI and MRA showed no abnormality, though later imaging did reveal cerebellar issues, suggesting secondary complications rather than the primary cause.

rejected.label: Severe Sepsis
rejected.why: While the patient has hepatic and renal dysfunction, these can be complications of heat stroke rather than indicators of sepsis as the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
rejected.why: DIC is present but is more likely a complication of the heat stroke rather than the primary diagnosis itself.
